apps.name: K3 Browser
apps.subtitle: Native WKWebView browser baseline
apps.localizedDescription: Native iOS WKWebView browser for sideloading. No DDG entitlements, no extensions, no app groups. Includes URL/search bar, back/forward/reload, share sheet, progress indicator, persistent WKWebsiteDataStore, and native Agent Snapshot panel for extracting page text and links.
apps.versionDescription: Agent Snapshot build: adds native ⚡ Agent panel, page title/URL/text/link extraction via WKWebView evaluateJavaScript, copy snapshot, and share snapshot.
